claude.result:
All 306 tests passing! The duplicate customer merge feature is complete with 22 comprehensive tests covering:

- **Existing customer functions** (7): normalizeId, getCustomer, listCustomers
- **mergeCustomers function** (15): 
  - Basic merge (moving invoices, removing source, keeping target)
  - ID normalization (whitespace, case)
  - Error handling (unknown customers, same customer)
  - Data integrity (no mutations, property preservation)
  - Complex scenarios (multiple customers/invoices)

The implementation:
- `mergeCustomers(customers, invoices, fromId, intoId)` → ok({ customers, invoices }) or error
- Removes fromId customer from array
- Updates all fromId invoices to intoId
- Returns new arrays (no mutations)
- Errors: CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND, SAME_CUSTOMER
- Normalizes IDs before comparison
